english.title: Fail to report adverse reaction to / failure of dog microchip - Wales
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) having identified

(A)_[an adverse reaction to]_
(B)_[the failure of]_

a microchip, failed to report that

(C)_[reaction]_
(D)_[failure]_

to the Welsh Ministers
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 10(1) and 13(2)(d) of the Microchipping of Dogs (Wales) Regulations 2015.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
identified adverse reaction to / failure of microchip
failed to report to Welsh Ministers

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Adverse reaction means -
(a) any unnecessary pain or suffering, or any pathology on the part of a dog which is caused, or appears to be caused, by the implanting of a microchip; or
(b) the migration of a microchip from the site of implanting.
(ii) Failure of a microchip means failure to transmit the number encoded in the microchip when scanned by an appropriate transceiver.
